title: Folders in My Brain
paragraphs: It was around midnight… when Father brought home Older Sister’s older sister in grand style.
“Even though things were so vague, for Sadeena-nee to come… Could it be that Naofumi-sama and Sadeena-nee are…”

What really stuck with me was the quiet murmur my Older Sister let slip as she went to greet Father. That’s what they call a girl’s heart, isn’t it? I’m quite the expert on romance, so I understand it well. To put it bluntly, aiming to be Cupid for Father and my Older Sister from now on sounds like a good plan. If it goes well, I can earn their strong trust, which might help strengthen my relationship with Filo-chan. After all, I want to be blessed by everyone around Filo-chan, too.
“Motoyasu, are you sure this guy’s the one?”
When I went out to greet him in front of the inn, Father said this with his arms crossed. I didn’t doubt him for a second, but to bring my Older Sister along so easily—that’s just like Father.
“Oh?”
“That’s right. Why are you asking me, though?”

“Well, I went around a few taverns, picked out someone who seemed like they’d understand, and mentioned Raphtalia’s name—and they did nod, mind you. But Zeltoble is the kind of place where people might just be pretending to know what they’re talking about. That’s why I asked you guys, just to be on the safe side.”
He’s the type who likes to be extra cautious. It seems Big Sister understands that as well.
“Raphtalia-chan? You’ve grown so much—you’ve become so beautiful, Older Sister, I didn’t even recognize you at first glance.”
“It’s been a long time… Sadeena-neesan.”

Older Sister gives her a big hug. She hugs her back, clearly delighted by the reunion. This is the Kizuna between sisters separated by life’s twists and turns. It’s a truly moving moment. Since I’ve also experienced reuniting with Filo-tan after a long loop, I can really relate to this.
“So… I heard a little bit about this on my way here, but Raphtalia-chan, you’re serving as Naofumi-chan’s slave, aren’t you?”
“Yes. I’ve had the symbol engraved so that Lord Naofumi, the Shield Hero, would… trust in my strength.”

What loyalty! In this world, her Older Sister must have had the mark forcibly removed at one point, so she’s had it engraved again. In other words, she must have shown the same proof of loyalty in the first world as well.

Seeing her Older Sister’s truly noble and admirable demeanor, I started to think that maybe I should show some proof of loyalty myself. However, you can’t enslave a Hero. Hmm… Well then, how about I get a brand—no, a tattoo modeled after Lady Filolial—on my body instead of a slave mark?
“Personally, I don’t think there’s any need to go that far,”
I was about to say that, but Father and the others were still talking. I’m not the kind of tactless guy who would interrupt a conversation between Father and Big Sister, so I kept quiet.
“This is the token I desired, Naofumi-sama.”
“…Ah, that’s right.”

As Father and Big Sister gazed at each other like that, my Older Sister watched them with a teasing expression, her hand pressed to her cheek. That’s it, isn’t it? Romance! Since I, too, had an encounter with Filo-tan that set my heart aflame with love, I understand it all too well.
“I’m currently working as a companion to Naofumi-sama, the Shield Hero. Our goal is to fight against the waves that devastated the village… so that no more victims like us will be created.”

My Older Sister stated this with great conviction. It’s a bit different from what she said in the world where we managed to save her. I think this is partly due to the different starting point of the loop.
“Sis, isn’t your goal to rebuild the village?”
“…Yes, that’s right. I did have the goal of rebuilding the village.”
Oh? She’s looking off into the distance. What’s the matter? Does that mean it’s no longer a priority?
“Sadeena, you know what’s become of that village now, don’t you?”
“…Yes.”
Older Sister’s Older Sister is nodding as if she understands what my older sister is trying to say. What has become of that village?
“Everyone is gone from that place now. The village I wanted to protect was gone. I know that.”
“Are you giving up, then?”
My Older Sister shakes her head at my question.
“No. But I think there are a lot of things we have to do right now. We can’t rebuild it immediately.”
“No matter what we do, we have to lay the groundwork first. There’s a lot that needs to be done. Whether we’re taking on the waves… or rebuilding the village.”
That’s right. Lady Filolial, money, equipment, Lv, and personnel. We can’t afford to neglect any of these. We’ll need to secure them one by one, step by step.
“Motoyasu, the Three Heroes Sect is a major obstacle to proving my innocence, isn’t it?”
“That’s right. Based on my experience in these loops, even if we turned to the Queen right now, I don’t think the situation would be resolved immediately.”

The Three Heroes Sect has revealed its true colors and is running rampant in collusion with Trash. It seems there were all sorts of troublesome skirmishes back then as well. And we don’t even know where Ren and Itsuki are… We’ve completely missed our chance to talk to them. In the end, the human rights of Demi-Humans and Therianthropes in Melromarc today are practically nonexistent.

“As far as Melromarc is concerned, it’s not a good idea to provoke them carelessly. Until that so-called queen resolves the situation, we’d be better off lying low and keeping the situation under control.”
“...You’re right. Since we’re the ones who put the princess in that state, I think it would be dangerous to go out there carelessly.”
“Oh? Don’t you want to live peacefully with your older sister, Raphtalia?”
Older Sister nodded at the words of her own Older Sister. There wasn’t a shred of lingering attachment in that nod.
“Yes. I don’t want to just reunite with Sadeena-nee and stay under her protection.”
“I see… I understand. It seems Raphtalia-chan’s resolve is firm, so I’ll do my best to support her too.”
That was quick. Just as you’d expect from Older Sister. Now that she’s joined us, our chances of winning have gone way up.
“However…”
Big Sister-in-law is glancing back and forth between Father and Older Sister. I wonder what’s up? Is she still worried about something?
“I think bringing Sadeena back in one go might be nothing short of a miracle…”
“I’d been told her distinguishing features. After that, if she was mingling with a group of people having a good time drinking, I’d be able to spot her.”
“Oh my! He was drinking with such a grumpy look on his face! It actually made me curious, so I went over to say hello.”
“Is that so?”
It’s true that at first glance, Father looks intimidating. But his heart is as vast and deep as the ocean of stars.
“That’s right. I could tell he was looking for someone, but I never would’ve guessed it was you, sis.”
“Well… I wasn’t even sure if you’d actually be there.”
“I’d just arrived in Zeltoble, and I was drinking while wondering, ‘What should I do now?’ I was really surprised. How did you know?”
“Hmm! I don’t want you to leave me behind, Father!”
Filo-tan came bounding out of the inn room. She spotted Father and threw herself into his arms.
“Father!”
Filo-chan is clinging tightly to Father. She’s rubbing her head against his body over and over. Father! I’m so jealous! I want you to do that to me, too!
“Even if we’re going to talk about that, it’s too noisy here. Let’s go back to our room at the inn and talk then.”
“Oh, so you’re bringing someone home. I wonder if it’ll be a fun night with the ladies?”
“You’re right in front of Raphtalia. Stop messing around.”
“Sadeena-nee, Lord Naofumi doesn’t like that sort of talk, so please don’t tease him too much.”
“Oh?”
Father is a sincere and upright man, after all. He’s nothing like the frivolous, easygoing guy I used to be. I, too, am working hard to be more like him so that I can be with Filo-tan.
“Master, you’re not going anywhere else, are you?”
Filo-chan is being affectionate with Father now that he’s back. What an adorable reaction.
“Not tonight. I brought you a souvenir.”
Saying that, Father handed Filo-chan a skewer wrapped in leaves. Could it be that he even brought a souvenir for Filo-chan? As expected of Father—he’s so thoughtful.
“Yay! A souvenir!”
Filo-chan looks so happy, and that makes me happy, too. I’m starting to feel like I want to express this feeling physically.
“If you’ve been a good girl while I was away, I’ll turn a blind eye to a little selfishness. You’ve got to trust and rely on Raphtalia.”
“Big sis, will you protect me?”
“Of course. After all, I was right here with you the whole time while you were asleep, wasn’t I?”
“The Spear Guy didn’t do anything, did he?”
“Yes, I kept an eye on the Spear Hero.”
Of course. I wouldn’t do anything inappropriate to Filo-tan while she’s sleeping. I just talked a little bit about the future with her Older Sister. It’s the truth.
Anyway, this has really helped build Kizuna between Filo-tan and her Older Sister. I can tell from the trusting look she gives her Older Sister.
“Don’t worry, Filo. You’ve gained another Older Sister.”
So, I went into the inn room with Father and explained that I’d come from the future. Father filled in the details, so the conversation went smoothly and was quite easy.
“Oh my—is that so?”
Her older sister said that while looking at me.
“Wait, are you the Spear Hero? You?”
“That’s right! I’m Motoyasu Kitamura, The Love Hunter! Nice to meet you, Older Sister!”
“Well… you can tell at a glance that he’s a pretty weird guy. But what he’s saying is mostly accurate. It might be safer to call him a shady prophet rather than a hero.”
“That’s true…”
Father and Big Sister-in-law are muttering something to themselves.
“Motoyasu-chan, huh? I get it now.”

It looks like I’ll be able to build a good relationship with Older Sister, too. This should come in handy later on for getting together with Filo-tan. It’s not that I’m doing it because of the people around me… but I do want to get along well with those who are close to Filo-tan.
“So… as for what we should do from here on out…”
“There’s definitely going to be a commotion in Melromarc. So I think it’s best to operate secretly in Zeltoble as planned.”

Hmm? I don’t think anything in particular happened when I went to Melromarc today. At least, I didn’t sense any such atmosphere from the monster merchant. Father from the first world used to say that skilled merchants are well-informed. I can’t imagine someone like that wouldn’t know about the commotion in Melromarc…

“That’s true. First, we have to get stronger—we can’t even start otherwise—and we’ll need money, too. Using the Dragon Hourglass in Zeltoble… it seems we’ll need power or money just to get close to it.”
“Then wouldn’t it be a good idea to make a name for ourselves at the Colosseum? My Older Sister was actually thinking about using that to make some money, too.”

The conversation moved on while I was still thinking it over. But the Colosseum, huh? I’ve never participated myself, but it’s certainly a good way to make money. Above all, since you can earn fame there, there’s a high chance you’ll be able to do a Class Up, too.
“That sounds reasonable… If we use the money and items we get from slaying monsters to build trust while working in Zeltoble, we should be able to make it work.”
“What about Filo?”

“I hear it’s also a nation of merchants, so she could peddle goods in Zeltoble… or maybe work as a delivery person. If we travel around in a carriage as much as we want making deliveries, we might actually make a profit.”
“Yay!”
“I’ll help out too! The Filolials and I will team up with Filo-tan to run a delivery business!”
“No way! Don’t come!”
Feero-tan is getting really excited! I’m starting to get into it too.
“As for the rest, by building connections among merchants—or rather, gaining influence with the merchants’ guild—and arranging for Class Up, we can make Raphtalia and the others stronger too.”
Wow, that’s Father for you. It seems he immediately figured out how to get ahead in Zeltoble.
“While we’re at it, maybe we should try to bring over some folks from Raphtalia’s village through our slave connections. It’s impossible for us to go to Melromarc to buy them, after all.”
“Oh, please do!”
When Big Sister bowed her head, Father waved his hand as if to say, “Don’t worry about it.”

“In that case, let’s buy up a building somewhere to use as a base and make sure we can hide the people from Raphtalia’s village there. Well… things will work out eventually once the Queen of Melromarc returns. We’ll just have to be patient until then.”
Father crossed his arms and smiled defiantly. My kind Father never used to look like that. But it’s a truly reassuring expression.
“Zeltoble… Judging by their reactions over the past few days, unlike in Melromarc, even I’m getting a normal response from them. At this rate, there’s nothing we can’t handle.”
That’s right. This is the chance for Father to show what he’s really made of!
“I’m itching to get started. It looks like things are going to get busy from here on out.”
“I think things are already plenty busy…”
“Well then, to celebrate our meeting tonight, shall we have a fun little drinking contest? Naofumi-chan, Motoyasu-chan.”
“I’ll pass.”

After all, Father is the only one who gets to have an evening drink with Older Sister. Above all, I’m burdened with the mission to live with integrity until the world achieves true peace. I have to keep my entertainment in moderation.
“Now that we’ve wrapped up our discussion, how about you guys go out for another drink, Father?”

It reminds me of Filo-tan singing at the tavern. If the same thing were to happen in this world, a new image would be saved in my mental folder. Just thinking about it… hehe, doesn’t it? With a smile like that, my gaze naturally drifted toward Filo-chan… and our eyes met.
“Yaa! The guy with the spear is grinning!”
“Filo, I know he’s scary, but cut him some slack. That said… does this guy even want to be liked…?”
“Does he even plan on staying home with Filo in the first place?”

No, I meant that Filo-tan and I are going along too, right? …Admittedly, the way I phrased it just now does make it sound like we’re staying behind. Well, I’m fine with that, though. No, actually, wouldn’t that be even better? Just me and Filo-chan alone… it’s paradise…
With that thought, I gaze at Filo-chan with a dreamy expression. Then Filo-chan, ruffling her feathers, said,
“No way!”
“Ugh, you’re so noisy! I’m not going, so just be quiet!”

It was quite a noisy night, with Father making all that racket. Later, while my Older Sister was drinking and reminiscing about her reunion with Big Sister, I sent some Lucor Fruit to Father as a little gift. At first, he looked at them suspiciously, but it seemed they suited his taste and he really enjoyed them.

Seeing that, Older Sister’s older sister’s eyes seemed to light up. I remember how they’d get along better every time this happened. I’m a guy who’ll do anything for Filo-tan and Father. HAHAHA! And so, the night Older Sister joined the group came to an end.
